outcome: Fractional tissue oxygen extraction of the brain (CtFOE)
Fractional tissue oxygen extraction of the kidneys (RtFOE)
Fractional tissue oxygen extraction of the splanchnic tissue (MtFOE)
cohort: 61 term infants delivered by elective caesarean section
finding: The study found that during the first 9 hours of life, oxygen delivery is prioritized to the brain, with lower oxygen saturation observed in the kidneys and splanchnic tissue, but this difference diminishes over time.
